content.short: Wonderverse is a DAO project management tool and Web3 credentialing platform.
content.description: Wonderverse is a web app that enables DAOs to manage projects on-chain through assignments, tracked completions, and reward mechanisms. It also includes Web3 features such as token gating, on-chain resumes, and batch payments to DAO contributors. Together, these capabilities provide a unified toolkit for planning and coordinating work, maintaining verifiable on-chain records of tasks and outcomes, and distributing rewards to contributors. The result is a streamlined workflow and more efficient human resources management for decentralized organizations.
content.meta: Wonderverse helps DAOs manage projects on-chain with assignments, completions, and rewards. Discover Wonderverse and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
